goal: Phase 1 (worker-side) of campaign register-skill-and-harden: every worker prompt says the controller's verification is the proof, adapters declare whether their sandbox can signal processes and dsh workers hear it, dsh workers get a clean git environment, and a contract-level sharedVerification runs the fast repository ratchets on every node. Spec: docs/campaigns/register-skill-and-harden/spec/SPEC.md.

taskPacket.objective: Workers know what their sandbox cannot run: every prompt states the controller's verification is the proof, each harness adapter declares `signalsProcesses`, a dsh worker's prompt carries a Sandbox section, and the dsh environment no longer inherits the broken GIT_CONFIG_* family.
instructions: Read the decisions in docs/campaigns/register-skill-and-harden/spec/SPEC.md and AGENTS.md ('Source tree rules'). Evidence from the previous campaign: three worker stalls and one blocked_context came from dsh workers running tests that terminate child processes inside a sandbox that cannot signal processes or read `ps` (the same commands passed in 51 s outside it), and a dsh worker saw GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 with GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0/1 but no GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0/1, so every `git init` in its tests failed with status 128.

Capability. In src/harnesses/index.mjs add `signalsProcesses` to CAPABILITY_NAMES and the CapabilityName typedef, accepting true, false or null (null = unmeasured); every adapter declares it: dsh `false` (measured 2026-09-16, workspace-write), claude `true` (bypassPermissions runs an unsandboxed Bash; acceptEdits cannot run commands at all, so the flag describes the executing mode), replay `false` (it executes nothing), codex `null`, agy `null`, zcode `null`, exec-jsonl `null` -- with one comment each saying measured or unmeasured. Whatever validates capability objects (validateCapabilityRequirements, harnessCapabilities, missingCapabilities) must accept the tri-state; a `requiredCapabilities: {signalsProcesses: true}` on a node must be satisfiable only by an adapter declaring true.

Prompt. In src/contract/task-packet.mjs the '## Verification' paragraph of renderWorkerPrompt, renderAutonomousPrompt and renderDiscoveryPrompt changes to: `The controller runs every command below after you report; its recorded results are the proof of this node. Running a command yourself is optional and only for one that finishes in seconds and spawns no long-lived process. Keep output bounded (pipe through \`| tail -n 200\`). Never wait on a background job, never run the whole test suite, and never run tests that start and terminate other processes.` Keep the list of commands and the '## Required output' section as they are. Update test/contract/packet.test.mjs where it asserts the old sentence.

Sandbox section. Add `appendSandboxNotice(prompt, runtime)` to src/engine/prompts.mjs: when the runtime's harness declares `signalsProcesses === false` (use harnessCapabilities from src/harnesses/index.mjs), append `## Sandbox\nYour harness runs you in a sandbox that cannot signal other processes or read the process table. A test that starts and terminates a child process hangs here until the executor's cap and is then killed as a stall. Do not run such tests; the controller runs them after you report.`; otherwise return the prompt unchanged. Call it in src/engine/dispatch.mjs right after appendPreviousAttempt for the worker phase (both dispatch sites that append the previous attempt), passing the resolved worker runtime. Cover it in a new test/engine/sandbox-notice.test.mjs: a dsh runtime gets the section, a claude runtime does not, an unmeasured harness does not.

dsh environment. src/harnesses/dsh/index.mjs `command(runtime, prompt, options)` returns the command the engine spawns; src/engine/process.mjs passes `command.env` through when present. Make the dsh command carry an env derived from process.env with every `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_<n>` and `GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_<n>` removed and `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` set (it keeps git from prompting, which is what the removed variables were for). Prove it in test/harnesses/dsh.test.mjs with the fake dsh fixture dumping its environment: the family is absent and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT is 0; every other variable survives.

Reference. skills/faberun/references/contract.md: in the paragraph on `permissionExecution`, one sentence naming `signalsProcesses` and what it means for packets (engineering.md and rules.md are reserved constitution articles no contract may write; the orchestrator updates them). contract.md has a byte ceiling of 21504 in test/docs/docs-diet.test.mjs and is at 21378, so trim redundancy in the same file first and raise the ceiling only by the bytes the sentence costs, with a dated comment in the style of the existing raises.

Run tsc and `node --test test/contract/ test/harnesses/ test/engine/sandbox-notice.test.mjs test/docs/` yourself (they spawn only the fake harness fixtures, which signal nothing) and fix what they report. Never run npm install in the worktree; never run the whole suite yourself; never run tests that start and terminate child processes (test/run/, test/engine/seal-before-kill, unfreezable, supervise, judge, resume) -- your dsh sandbox cannot signal processes and they hang until the executor cap; the controller runs them as this node's verification.
decisions: signalsProcesses is tri-state per adapter; dsh false and claude true are measured, the rest null until measured.
The verification paragraph flips the default: the controller's run is the proof, self-runs are optional and process-free.
The Sandbox section is appended at dispatch from the resolved runtime, not baked into the packet prompt.
dsh gets GIT_CONFIG_* stripped and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0; other harnesses keep their environment.
nonGoals: Do not change what verification commands run or when; sharedVerification is the next node.
Do not measure codex, agy or zcode sandboxes here; declare null.

Never run npm install in the worktree; never run the whole suite yourself; never run tests that start and terminate child processes (test/run/, test/engine/seal-before-kill, unfreezable, supervise, judge, resume) -- your dsh sandbox cannot signal processes and they hang until the executor cap; the controller runs them as this node's verification.

definitionOfDone.text: contract, harness, sandbox-notice and docs tests pass
all three renderers carry the new verification paragraph, a dsh worker prompt gets the Sandbox section at dispatch, and the dsh command env has no GIT_CONFIG_* and has GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
every adapter declares signalsProcesses with a measured/unmeasured comment and the validator accepts the tri-state

taskPacket.objective: A contract may declare `sharedVerification`: commands appended to every node's verification (attempt and integration candidate), counted in budgets and in preflight timing, so a node that breaks a repository ratchet fails on its own attempt instead of on the phase-terminal node's full suite.
instructions: Read docs/campaigns/register-skill-and-harden/spec/SPEC.md ('sharedVerification') and the evidence: in become-faberun, install-script (a shell script node) was rejected twice and re-run four times because the phase-terminal full suite caught a raw git spawn from setup-onboarding and a missing FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md declaration from the signal guard -- defects the fast ratchets (test/repo/source-shape.test.mjs ~1 s, test/campaign/field-ownership.test.mjs ~1 s, test/repo/brand.test.mjs, test/docs/) would have caught on the offending node.

Schema. In src/contract/index.mjs add `sharedVerification` to CONTRACT_FIELDS and the ValidatedContract typedef, validated with the same validator finalVerification uses (validateVerificationCommands via a `validateSharedVerification` in src/contract/final-verification.mjs, or reuse validateFinalVerification with its own label), persisted with the contract, and part of contractDigest by construction. Add `sharedVerificationCommands(contract)` next to finalVerificationCommands in src/contract/final-verification.mjs (every node gets them; order: node verification, then shared, then final).

Engine. src/engine/verify.mjs merges `[...node.taskPacket.verification, ...sharedVerificationCommands(contract), ...finalVerificationCommands(contract, node)]` at both call sites; src/engine/scheduler.mjs's verification budget (verificationBudgetMs / the derived budget the heartbeat uses) counts the shared commands including repeat; src/host/preflight.mjs declaredVerificationCommands / timeVerificationCommands include them once. The judge prompt already receives `{argv, passed}` for green commands; nothing changes there.

Tests. test/contract/contract.test.mjs: the field is accepted, validated (a bad entry names `contract.sharedVerification[0]`), and an unknown field is still rejected. New test/engine/shared-verification.test.mjs driving a two-node run with the replay or fake harness the surrounding tests use: both nodes' recorded verification includes the shared command; a failing shared command fails the node whose attempt ran it (not the other); the phase-terminal node still gets finalVerification after the shared ones; preflight --time-verification lists the shared command once.

Documentation. skills/faberun/references/contract.md: one paragraph under the finalVerification text defining sharedVerification and its intended use (fast ratchets); docs/CONCEPTS.md 'Definition of done and its proofs' (or the verification section): one sentence. rules.md is a reserved constitution article no contract may write; the orchestrator adds its clause. Ceiling for contract.md in test/docs/docs-diet.test.mjs is 21504 -- trim first, raise only by the bytes the text costs with a dated comment.

Run tsc and `node --test test/contract/ test/docs/` yourself and fix what they report. Do NOT run test/engine/shared-verification.test.mjs yourself: it drives real runs and terminates their processes, which hangs in your sandbox until the executor cap (the previous worker stalled twice doing exactly that); the controller runs it as this node's verification and that result is the proof. If the work is already present in the tree (a previous attempt sealed it), verify it against these instructions and report done with a summary. Never run npm install in the worktree; never run the whole suite yourself; never run tests that start and terminate child processes (test/run/, test/engine/seal-before-kill, unfreezable, supervise, judge, resume) -- your dsh sandbox cannot signal processes and they hang until the executor cap; the controller runs them as this node's verification.
decisions: Same schema and validator as finalVerification; order node, shared, final.
Shared commands run on every attempt and candidate and are budgeted like node verification.
Documented in contract.md and CONCEPTS.md within their ceilings; the reserved articles are the orchestrator's.
nonGoals: Do not change finalVerification semantics or the judge prompt.
Do not add shared commands to any existing contract here.

Never run npm install in the worktree; never run the whole suite yourself; never run tests that start and terminate child processes (test/run/, test/engine/seal-before-kill, unfreezable, supervise, judge, resume) -- your dsh sandbox cannot signal processes and they hang until the executor cap; the controller runs them as this node's verification.

definitionOfDone.text: contract, shared-verification and docs tests pass
shared commands reach both verify.mjs call sites, the budget and preflight timing, and the persisted contract carries the field
